Se Traspasa PIZZERIA con LICENCIA DE BAR Y MUSICA, 160M2, completamente equipada y lista para comenzar! 
Excelente ubicación en Málaga, zona Teatinos!

Tiene 2 Terrazas con permiso (por el momento le han dado de baja)
En la zona interior hay 10 mesas con 4 sillas y 1 mesa grande con 7 a 9 sillas.
2 baños
Tiene 1 almacen con 2 altillos.
Cocina con conexion de gas natural 4 fuegos, puede conectar tambien a electricidad.
Horno grande de leña para las pizzas y barra.
Tiene freidora, nevera, lavavajillas, congelador grande.

Alquiler mensual 1.500€ + IVA
le quedan 2 años de contrato de alquiler con opción a renovar por 5 años mas.

Contáctanos para brindarte mayor información y organizar una visita.
inv.desc_en:
PIZZERIA for transfer with BAR AND MUSIC LICENSE, 160m2, fully equipped and ready to start!
Excellent location in Malaga, Teatinos area!

It has 2 terraces with permits (currently suspended).
In the interior area, there are 10 tables with 4 chairs each and 1 large table with 7 to 9 chairs.
2 bathrooms.
It has 1 storage room with 2 lofts.
Kitchen with natural gas connection for 4 burners, can also be connected to electricity.
Large wood-fired oven for pizzas and a bar.
Includes deep fryer, refrigerator, dishwasher, and large freezer.

Monthly rent €1,500 + VAT.
There are 2 years left on the lease contract with the option to renew for 5 more years.

Contact us to provide you with more information and to organize a visit.
